show.title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London

show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/m7AR9R
show.description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.
